tasks.subject: Task 1: Content type layer + helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Hand-written Block/PageContent types and child/field accessors that generated files and pages depend on.

**Files:** Create content/_types.ts, content/_helpers.ts; Test __tests__/content-helpers.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:** Block recursive with optional image/quote; child returns match/throws when absent; field returns value/throws when absent; tsc --noEmit and jest helper test pass.

**Verify:** npx jest content-helpers --silent && npx tsc --noEmit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["content/_types.ts", "content/_helpers.ts", "__tests__/content-helpers.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx jest content-helpers --silent && npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Block recursive with optional image/quote", "child returns match, throws when absent", "field returns value, throws when absent", "tsc + jest pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Markdown parser
tasks.description:
**Goal:** parsePage(markdown) → { title, order, sections } recursive Block tree.

**Files:** Create scripts/lib/content-parse.mjs; Test scripts/lib/content-parse.test.mjs

**Acceptance Criteria:** headings nest by depth; fields/items/wrapped+split paragraphs; image+caption and standalone links; blockquote text+author; camelCased slug keys with & → and; literal unicode preserved.

**Verify:** node --test scripts/lib/content-parse.test.mjs

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/lib/content-parse.mjs", "scripts/lib/content-parse.test.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "node --test scripts/lib/content-parse.test.mjs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["headings nest by depth", "fields/items/wrapped+split paragraphs", "image+caption and links", "blockquote text+author", "camelCased keys, & → and, literal unicode"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Deterministic TS emitter
tasks.description:
**Goal:** emitPage(constName, sourceFile, sections) → byte-identical TS module source.

**Files:** Create scripts/lib/content-emit.mjs; Test scripts/lib/content-emit.test.mjs

**Acceptance Criteria:** do-not-edit banner names source file; imports PageContent and ends with export const ... satisfies PageContent; JSON-escaped strings; emitting twice byte-identical.

**Verify:** node --test scripts/lib/content-emit.test.mjs

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/lib/content-emit.mjs", "scripts/lib/content-emit.test.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "node --test scripts/lib/content-emit.test.mjs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["banner names source file", "imports PageContent, satisfies PageContent", "JSON-escaped, deterministic"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Validator + manifest
tasks.description:
**Goal:** validatePage(name, page, config) → precise error strings (empty = valid), incl. portfolio/interests joins.

**Files:** Create scripts/lib/content-manifest.mjs, scripts/lib/content-validate.mjs; Test scripts/lib/content-validate.test.mjs

**Acceptance Criteria:** missing section/empty body/missing field error by name; portfolio join errors (no **id:**, no card, image/displayType mismatch, link href mismatch); interests id-set mismatch; valid page returns [].

**Verify:** node --test scripts/lib/content-validate.test.mjs

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/lib/content-manifest.mjs", "scripts/lib/content-validate.mjs", "scripts/lib/content-validate.test.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "node --test scripts/lib/content-validate.test.mjs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["section/body/field errors", "portfolio join errors", "interests id mismatch", "valid → []"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Sync orchestrator + npm/gitignore wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** runSync() reads content/*.md, parse+validate all, writes content/generated/*.ts only on zero errors; CLI + npm/gitignore wiring.

**Files:** Create scripts/sync-content.mjs, scripts/sync-content.test.mjs; Modify .gitignore, package.json

**Acceptance Criteria:** runSync writes for valid content; error → no write + errors; CLI summary + non-zero exit (Windows-safe); gitignore un-ignores content/**/*.md only; npm scripts wired so build runs sync first.

**Verify:** node --test scripts/sync-content.test.mjs && npm run content:sync

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/sync-content.mjs", "scripts/sync-content.test.mjs", ".gitignore", "package.json"], "verifyCommand": "node --test scripts/sync-content.test.mjs && npm run content:sync", "acceptanceCriteria": ["writes valid content", "error → no write", "CLI exit codes Windows-safe", "gitignore + npm wiring"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Bootstrap content + structural config
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Author six content/*.md verbatim from current copy + lib/page-config.json + lib/page-config.ts; run sync; commit generated. Net text change zero.

**Files:** Create content/{home,portfolio,portfolio-ej-prisons,interests,resume,site}.md, lib/page-config.json, lib/page-config.ts; generated content/generated/*.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:** markdown matches parser format + manifest keys; entities → literal Unicode; content:sync exits 0 writes 6 files; tsc --noEmit passes.

**Verify:** npm run content:sync && npx tsc --noEmit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["content/home.md", "content/portfolio.md", "content/portfolio-ej-prisons.md", "content/interests.md", "content/resume.md", "content/site.md", "lib/page-config.json", "lib/page-config.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run content:sync && npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["format + manifest keys", "entities → unicode", "sync writes 6 files", "tsc passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Render portfolio + interests from content
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Repurpose lib/portfolio-data.ts to merge config + generated text → same PROJECTS; feed portfolio/interests pages from content; components unchanged.

**Files:** Modify lib/portfolio-data.ts, app/portfolio/page.tsx, app/interests/page.tsx

**Acceptance Criteria:** same Project interface + PROJECTS/getters; ProjectIndex/LazyProjectMap unmodified and working; portfolio + interests render identically at 390 and 1440.

**Verify:** npm run build && npm test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/portfolio-data.ts", "app/portfolio/page.tsx", "app/interests/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["same exports", "components unmodified", "parity 390/1440"]}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:** home hero/expertise/passions from home; EJ header/overview/objectives/team(3 two-line bios)/role/impact(quote+thanks)/CTA from portfolioEjPrisons; both render identically at 390 and 1440.

tasks.subject: Task 9: Render resume + footer + SEO from content
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Resume page, footer blurb, and layout SEO metadata come from generated content.

**Acceptance Criteria:** resume header/experience/education/skills/achievements from resume; footer blurb from site.footer.body; SEO title/description/keywords from site.seo; render identically.

**Verify:** npm run content:sync && npm run build && npm test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/resume/page.tsx", "components/layout/Footer.tsx", "app/layout.tsx", "content/resume.md"], "verifyCommand": "npm run content:sync && npm run build && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["resume from content", "footer + SEO from site", "identical render"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Full-site parity & health verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the whole site renders identically to pre-refactor, the build pipeline regenerates content, all tests pass.

**Files:** none (verification + cleanup)

**Acceptance Criteria:** build runs content:sync then 8/8 pages; Jest 32/32 + test:content pass; re-sync produces no git diff (deterministic); content/**/*.md tracked; all 5 routes render identically at 390 and 1440.

**Verify:** npm run content:sync && git diff --quiet content/generated && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:content

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "npm run content:sync && git diff --quiet content/generated && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:content", "acceptanceCriteria": ["build syncs + 8/8", "Jest 32/32 + test:content", "deterministic no-diff", "content md tracked", "5 routes parity 390/1440"]}
```
